title: Goa
description: An independent civic and tourism website concept for Goa, Camarines Sur. The design brings resident services and visitor information into one warm, readable experience.
imageAlt: Goa independent civic website concept homepage, with navigation and citizen-services introduction over a church photograph.
context: Independent concept; not an official municipality website. The demo includes placeholder content and hotline details, which must not be used as official information.
decisions: Two audiences, one navigation: resident services and tourism information.
A shared visual language balances civic clarity with a welcoming destination feel.
Theme and accessibility controls are part of the documented interface.

title: GCash Message Dashboard
summary: Turning transaction messages into a readable overview.
description: A personal dashboard that organizes transaction messages into spending patterns, balances, and a searchable ledger. An expressive visual hierarchy makes the overview distinct from the detailed transaction view.
imageAlt: GCash Message Dashboard overview with lime and violet panels displaying synthetic transaction data.
context: Independent personal project, not commissioned or endorsed by GCash. The public demo uses synthetic transaction data; figures shown are illustrative.
decisions: A summary-first overview with a transaction ledger available on demand.
Separate visual treatments distinguish incoming money, spending, and allocation.
Documented privacy masking keeps sensitive values hidden without changing the layout.

title: Vibra
description: An audio-visual instrument with an editorial gallery and an interactive listening studio. A Three.js sculpture turns musical energy into form, with controls that let the listener shape the visual response.
imageAlt: Vibra homepage with the words Give sound a body beside a pearlescent sculpture on a plum background.
context: Personal creative experiment. The repository documents local audio playback and analysis in the browser; audio recognition and tempo detection are not guaranteed.
decisions: An editorial homepage introduces the artwork before the listening controls.
The studio keeps playback and visual tuning close to the sculpture.
The documented visual response favors composed movement rather than reacting dramatically to every sound.

title: PH Budget Investigator
summary: A workspace for exploring public budget information.
description: A personal research interface for browsing statutory budget records, comparing funding trajectories, and keeping source references near the analysis. The portfolio focuses on information organization and the investigative workflow.
imageAlt: PH Budget Investigator newsroom interface with search, forensic angles, budget trend bars, and source data.
context: Statutory allocations are not actual spending or completed projects. Anomaly indicators are research leads, not proof of wrongdoing. The repository credits Jaemark Tordecilla’s budget-bot projects as a foundational data layer.
decisions: Compare trajectories while preserving the distinction between allocations and spending.
Keep references and methodological caveats adjacent to investigative views.
Separate an indicator that prompts research from a conclusion supported by evidence.

title: Deadline Widget
summary: A small desktop home for upcoming deadlines.
description: A personal macOS productivity widget that brings academic deadlines into a compact floating view. Priority, completion, and urgency states help organize what needs attention.
imageAlt: Deadline Widget displayed on a macOS desktop, showing calendar panels and deadline cards.
context: Personal macOS desktop tool shown in its local desktop context. It is not an inbox integration.
decisions: A compact floating format keeps deadlines close without becoming a full productivity app.
Urgency, priority, and completion are distinct states.
Actual inbox data is excluded from this portfolio presentation.

title: Service-business landing page
summary: A place for the next practical website project.
description: Reserved for a future landing-page project focused on clear services and a straightforward inquiry path.
imageAlt: Simple plus mark indicating a future project placeholder.
context: Hypothetical placeholder. No client, completed work, delivery date, or result is claimed.
